ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; the surface area is >95% low-intensity with high-intensity pixels limited to discrete focal specks and the median notch vertex.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) field covers the entire visible fluke surface. Small, high-contrast white circular spots (radius 1-3 pixels) are stochastically distributed across both lobes. A contiguous high-intensity (white) triangular region is localized at the median notch vertex. Linear white streaks are visible in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) forming a jagged continuous linear boundary along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward sweep trajectory originating from the median notch and extending to the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the black pigmentation, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned curved linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized in the lower-lateral quadrants of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple linear rake marks and numerous small circular white scars across the ventral surface; no evidence of amputations or major physical trauma visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely uniform dark pigmentation (near-solid black) across the ventral surface, which is a distinctive contrast to typical mottled humpback patterns.
